### Photos that hold up in every shot

The model rebuilds the scorer from your photo in every shot. Better input, more recognisable goal.

#### Works best

- One person or pet in the photo

- Face toward the camera, eyes visible

- Even daylight, no harsh shadows

- At least 720px wide, head and shoulders or full body

#### Avoid

- Group photos or cropped-out friends

- Sunglasses, masks, heavy filters

- Children, celebrities, footballers or anyone who hasn't agreed

- Tiny, blurry or screenshot-of-a-screenshot images

## Where the Ozil goal came from

People put themselves — or their friends, or their dogs — into one famous goal: a calm chip over the keeper, two defenders sliding past an empty net, and a tap-in that takes its time. AI rebuilds the whole move around the face from a single photo.

Ozil AI is an independent fan tool, not affiliated with Mesut Özil, Arsenal, Ludogorets or UEFA. Our films use AI-made players and stadiums, never match footage.
